doc:
# RGFlow — Renormalization

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “holographic RG flow”).

claims.name: every_holographic_rg_flow_ads
claims.statement: For every holographic RG flow in AdS3, there is a corresponding holographic RG flow in flat space.

sources.title: Carrollian c-functions and flat space holographic RG flows in BMS3/CCFT2

claims.name: overline_operator_factorizes_along_holographic
claims.statement: The $T\overline{T}$ operator factorizes along the holographic RG flow for an exact RG flow solution.

sources.title: Zoo of flows in a 3d gauged supergravity with periodic potential

claims.name: holographic_rg_flow_consistency_supports
claims.statement: Holographic RG flow consistency supports the dS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: Asymptotically de Sitter dilatonic space-time, holographic RG flow and conformal anomaly from (dilatonic) dS/CFT correspondence

claims.name: large_rg_flows_interpreted_flow
claims.statement: Large $N$ RG flows are interpreted as flow velocities in holographic RG in two dimensions.

sources.title: 2D Black Hole and Holographic Renormalization Group

claims.name: holographic_rg_flow_identifies_wilsonian
claims.statement: Holographic RG flow identifies $z$ with the Wilsonian cutoff scale.

sources.title: Higher-spin composites and emergent AdS$_3$ geometry in the $(1+1)$-dimensional Gross-Neveu model

claims.name: paper_studies_holographic_entanglement_entropy
claims.statement: The paper studies holographic entanglement entropy under bulk RG flow.

sources.title: Holographic entanglement from the UV to the IR

claims.name: ricci_flow_equation_boundary_theory
claims.statement: A Ricci flow equation of the boundary theory is obtained as the holographic RG flow.

claims.name: holographic_rg_flow_equations_holographic
claims.statement: From holographic RG flow equations, the holographic $4d$ conformal anomaly with dilatonic contributions is calculated.

sources.title: Asymptotically de Sitter dilatonic space-time, holographic RG flow and conformal anomaly from (dilatonic) dS/CFT correspondence

claims.name: holographic_rg_flow_solutions_smooth
claims.statement: The holographic RG flow solutions are smooth and preserve four supercharges.

claims.name: symmetrybroken_viscosities_satisfy_nontrivial_holographic
claims.statement: The symmetry-broken viscosities satisfy non-trivial holographic $RG$-flow equations.

sources.title: Running Shear Viscosities in Anisotropic Holographic Superfluids

claims.name: holographic_gfunction_monotonically_nonincreasing_along
claims.statement: The holographic g-function is monotonically non-increasing along the RG flow.

sources.title: Holographic RG Flow on the Defect and g-Theorem

claims.name: holographic_techniques_used_interpret_moduli
claims.statement: Holographic techniques are used to interpret the moduli flow as an RG flow towards the IR attractor horizon.

sources.title: Moduli flow and non-supersymmetric AdS attractors

claims.name: holographic_dual_geometry_encodes_whole
claims.statement: The holographic dual geometry encodes the whole RG flow of the gauge theory.

claims.name: analytic_holographic_rg_flow_interpolates
claims.statement: An analytic holographic RG flow interpolates between the two $AdS_5$ critical points.

sources.title: Holographic RG flows and $AdS_5$ black strings from 5D half-maximal gauged supergravity

claims.name: superpotential_approach_used_analyze_holographic
claims.statement: The superpotential approach is used to analyze the holographic renormalization group (RG) flow.

sources.title: Higher order curvature corrections and holographic renormalization group flow

claims.name: axionic_holographic_rg_flow_solutions
claims.statement: Axionic holographic RG flow solutions are analyzed in general Einstein-axion-dilaton theories.

sources.title: Axion RG flows and the holographic dynamics of instanton densities

claims.name: computed_kk_couplings_encode_all
claims.statement: Computed KK couplings encode all two-point correlators along the holographic RG flow.

sources.title: A holographic RG flow from the squashed to the round $S^7$

claims.name: fgpw_flow_example_holographic_rg
claims.statement: The FGPW flow is an example of a holographic RG flow in a field theory on a flat background.

sources.title: The holographic RG flow in a field theory on a curved background
